record.name: Smartsheet
record.one_liner: A cloud-based platform for work management, project collaboration, and task automation.
record.access_note: API access requires a Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management plan.
record.api_note: The Smartsheet API covers sheets, folders, users, and more.
record.blocker_note: The Smartsheet API requires specific paid plans (Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management).

evidence.quote: The API authenticates using access tokens (API keys).
Required plan: Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management
The Smartsheet API enables you to programmatically access and manage your organization's Smartsheet resources.
The Smartsheet MCP Server is an open, protocol-based integration layer built on Anthropic's Model Context Protocol standard.
